render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # render at 50 FPS

# Create the vehicle system

init_loc = chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0.5)  # 0.5 m above ground to avoid initial penetration
init_rot = chrono.ChQuaternionD(1, 0, 0, 0)  # no rotation (identity quaternion)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysD(init_loc, init_rot))

# Set tire model to TMEASY
vehicle.SetTireType(veh.TireModelType_TMEASY)

# Use primitive visualization for vehicle components
vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)

# Initialize the vehicle system
vehicle.Initialize()

# Create the terrain (RigidTerrain)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())

# Define terrain patch dimensions and location
patch_length = 100.0
patch_width = 100.0
patch_height = 0.1  # thickness of the patch

patch.SetFriction(0.9f)
patch.SetMaterialSurface(veh.MaterialSurfaceType_TMEASY)

terrain.Initialize()

# 3. Set necessary default parameters such as positions, forces, and interactions.

# Create the interactive driver system
driver = veh.ChIrrGuiDriver(vehicle)

# Set steering, throttle, and braking time response (for smooth control)
driver.SetSteeringDelta(0.04)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(0.1)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(0.1)

# Initialize the driver system
driver.Initialize()

# Create the Irrlicht application for visualization
app = chronoirr.ChIrrApp(vehicle.GetSystem(), "HMMWV Full Vehicle Simulation", chronoirr.dimension2du(1280, 720))

# Add typical elements to Irrlicht scene
app.AddTypicalSky()
app.AddTypicalLights()
app.AddTypicalCamera(chronoirr.vector3df(0, -8, 3))

# Bind all assets and update all assets
app.AssetBindAll()
app.AssetUpdateAll()

# Set timestep for the Irrlicht application
app.SetTimestep(time_step)

# Simulation loop variables
time = 0
render_frame = 0
render_steps = int(1.0 / (time_step * 50))  # number of simulation steps per render frame

# Simulation loop
while app.GetDevice().run():
    app.BeginScene()
    app.DrawAll()

    # Driver inputs
    steering_input = driver.GetSteering()
    throttle_input = driver.GetThrottle()
    braking_input = driver.GetBraking()

    # Apply driver inputs to vehicle
    vehicle.GetSteering().SetInput(steering_input)
    vehicle.GetPowertrain().SetThrottle(throttle_input)
    vehicle.GetBraking().SetBrake(braking_input)

    # Advance simulation by time_step
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, steering_input, throttle_input, braking_input)
    app.Synchronize("", steering_input, throttle_input, braking_input)

    vehicle.Advance(time_step)
    terrain.Advance(time_step)
    driver.Advance(time_step)
    app.Advance(time_step)

    app.EndScene()

    time += time_step
    render_frame += 1

    # Sleep to maintain real-time at 50 FPS rendering
    if render_frame >= render_steps:
        chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer().Sleep(render_step_size)
        render_frame = 0

tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

# Create the HMMWV vehicle, set parameters, and initialize
vehicle = veh.HMMWV_Full()  # veh.HMMWV_Reduced() could be another choice here
vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
vehicle.SetTireType(tire_model)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(tire_step_size)

vehicle.Initialize()

vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the terrain
patch_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat, chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT), terrainLength, terrainWidth)
patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
terrain.Initialize()

# Create the vehicle Irrlicht interface
vis = veh.ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowTitle('HMMWV Demo')
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 0.5)
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())

# ------------------------
# 3. Path and Controller Implementation
# ------------------------

# Define a circular path with a reasonable radius
circle_radius = 30.0  # reasonable radius to fit inside terrain

# Create a path as a ChLinePath
path = veh.ChLinePath()
num_points = 100
for i in range(num_points + 1):
    angle = 2 * math.pi * i / num_points
    x = circle_radius * math.cos(angle)
    y = circle_radius * math.sin(angle)
    path.AddPoint(chrono.ChVectorD(x, y, 0))

path.Set_closed(True)

# Visualize the path using two balls at start and halfway point
ball_radius = 0.5
ball_start = chrono.ChBodyEasySphere(ball_radius, 1000, True, True)
ball_start.SetPos(path.GetPoint(0))
ball_start.SetBodyFixed(True)
vehicle.GetSystem().Add(ball_start)

ball_half = chrono.ChBodyEasySphere(ball_radius, 1000, True, True)
ball_half.SetPos(path.GetPoint(num_points // 2))
ball_half.SetBodyFixed(True)
vehicle.GetSystem().Add(ball_half)

# Create the path follower driver
driver = veh.ChPathFollowerDriver(vehicle, path, "my_path_follower")
driver.SetLookAheadDistance(5.0)  # lookahead distance for steering control
driver.SetGains(0.8, 0, 0.1)  # PID gains: Kp=0.8, Ki=0, Kd=0.1 (tune as needed)
driver.Initialize()

# Set constant throttle value of 0.3
driver.SetThrottle(0.3)

# ------------------------
# 5. Visualization of Controller Points (sentinel and target points)
# ------------------------

# Create spheres for sentinel and target points visualization
sentinel_sphere = chrono.ChBodyEasySphere(0.3, 1000, True, True)
sentinel_sphere.SetBodyFixed(True)
vehicle.GetSystem().Add(sentinel_sphere)

target_sphere = chrono.ChBodyEasySphere(0.3, 1000, True, True)
target_sphere.SetBodyFixed(True)
vehicle.GetSystem().Add(target_sphere)

# ------------------------
# Simulation loop setup
# ------------------------

# Output vehicle mass
print("VEHICLE MASS: ", vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run():
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0):
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Update driver inputs (path follower driver)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver.GetInputs(), terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver.GetInputs())

    # Update sentinel and target spheres positions for visualization
    sentinel_pos = driver.GetSentinelLocation()
    target_pos = driver.GetTargetLocation()
    sentinel_sphere.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(sentinel_pos.x, sentinel_pos.y, 0.3))
    target_sphere.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(target_pos.x, target_pos.y, 0.3))

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
